en: Most of you said nineteen. The real answer is seventeen.
First, Adam and Zara cross together. Two minutes.
Adam brings the torch back. One minute. That's three.
Now the big move. Omar and Grandad cross together. Ten minutes. Thirteen.
Zara brings the torch back. Two minutes. Fifteen.
Finally, Adam and Zara cross again. Two minutes.
Seventeen. Everyone is across, and the torch is still burning.
The secret? Send the two slowest together, so you only pay for Grandad once.
One of you got it right in the comments. Did you?
